The other tasks ran first ('after the other tasks it works with about CHF 0.29') and a second larger task was refused ('one task that large runs a session, so it waits for the next one'). The owner's answer 5 asks for the larger task to run in its turn.

fixed.how: cutPlanToBudget takes the items in the plan's order. The first task larger than the work budget goes in at its place, with what is left as its figure (wholeEstimateUsdMicro keeps the whole one), when that is at least a fifth of the budget. Every item after it is left out as 'after_large' with `after` naming the larger task, and with less than a fifth left it is 'no_room'. The runner's takeLarger plans it at its turn with the room left and logs 'Took "X", larger than this session's work budget, with about CHF N left.' once. The re-plan takes the after_large tasks first, by the room left. The start check (StartCheckOversized.before/comesAfter), oversize-words (oversizedSentence with the tasks before it, comesAfterSentence, waitsForNextSessionSentence, oversizedPlanClause's third argument), the Start dialog (start-session-comes-after), chat's read-back and the result's 'Left for next time' all say the same order. The fake daemon's fakeStartCheck cuts the same way.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Make a project with three ready tasks: 'Write the intro' (high, small), 'Build the shop page' (medium, estimate above the session's work budget) and 'Write the notes' (low, small). Press Start session with CHF 2.00. The dialog says 'This session runs "Write the intro..." (about CHF 0.04), then works on "Build the shop page..." with what is left.', the amber note says 'after "Write the intro..." it works with about CHF 1.56, keeps its work, and asks you to continue.' and '"Write the notes..." comes after it: it runs if "Build the shop page..." leaves budget, else in your next session.' Press Start. The session log shows the intro done, then 'Took "Build the shop page...", larger than this session's work budget, with about CHF 1.59 left.' once. The result says '"Write the notes..." waits for your next session: "Build the shop page..." used the rest of this one.'

fixed.problem: OP-0b: a task paused at the session's budget with progress waited on its card. A plain next Start did not take it, so the person had to answer the card before any work went on.

fixed.how: budget-card.ts adds continuesAtStart and continuableTasks: an open card at the session's budget (or at the specialist's limit as the session's last pause) with progress. The runner's start plan and startCheck include those tasks in their turn, priced at what is left. closeByStart withdraws the card as 'went_on_at_start' when the session claims the task, and the card's Done line reads 'Your session of 14:05 went on with it.'. The row detail and the card's explain name the next Start: 'Your next Start goes on with it, or Continue in the Inbox.' and 'Starts a session now with CHF N; without it, your next Start takes it in its turn.'. A no-progress pause and a pause at the task's own budget are not taken.
fixed.check_in_the_app: After the walk above, the Inbox card reads 'This session's budget was CHF 2.00; ...' with 'Continue (CHF 2.00 more)' and the explain '... without it, your next Start takes it in its turn.'. Open the task in Tasks: the drawer says 'Your next Start goes on with it, or Continue in the Inbox.'. Press Start session again without answering the card: the dialog plans 'Build the shop page' first at what is left. After the session, the card is under Inbox > Answered with 'Your session of HH:MM went on with it.'

fixed.problem: OP-1 and L3-left-4: the wrap-up line told the specialist only to stop. It did not say to leave the files in a state that can be continued (builds and runs, half-done changes undone or kept out of use), or to end with a 'Where I stopped:' and 'Left to do:' that the next run can start from.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/wrap-up.test.ts 'd1109-oversize-pause, run C: the words of a good wrap-up (OP-1)' > 'the text, word for word, with the run's share', 'the loop driver: the request after the line carries it once, after the tool results', 'the Agent SDK path: PostToolUse's additionalContext is the same words, once', 'the brief's line, word for word'
fixed.how: loop.ts wrapUpText and budget-pause.ts WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE now carry the owner's D4 in exact words. The loop driver sends the line on the request after the tool results. The SDK driver sends the same words through PostToolUse additionalContext. The brief carries the brief line.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Run a task that hits its wrap-up (bench: FORERUNNER_BENCH_LONG). On the session page with Details on, the step reads 'Told the coder to wrap up: it spent CHF 1.93 of CHF 2.40, ...'. The run's report in the task drawer ends with 'Where I stopped:' and 'Left to do:' as a list.

fixed.problem: OP-2 and OP-3: a paused run's kept work was committed without any check (checks ran only in the critic). The card, the result and the next brief said nothing about whether the work still passes the project's own checks.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/kept-work-check.test.ts (new, 6 cases: failing script in sandbox with no network, passing script, [REDACTED] and end-of-output, no sandbox runs nothing on the host, no checks, Stop now ends a sleeping check within 2 s); packages/runtime/test/oversize-pause.test.ts 'OP-2, OP-3, OP-7: a pause at its own budget: the failing test reaches the Run row redacted, the card, the result and the next brief as data'; apps/ui/test/inbox.test.tsx 'd1109-oversize-pause, run C' > 'OP-2: the card's first sentence says the project's test fails on its work; never the check's output'
fixed.how: The new loop/kept-work-check.ts keptWorkChecker runs the critic's codeTaskChecks (exported) in the task's sandbox. It uses allowedDomains [], the project-check timeout and the session's signal, and never runs on the host. It keeps the end of each output (at most 1,500 characters), redacted with the vault's values, and books nothing. compose.ts wires it in one hunk. The runner's keepPausedWork stores { kept: {hash, checks, notRun, noProgress} } on the Run row (RunKept) and passes {passed, failed} to the card. requestWords adds '; the project's test fails on its work.'. The result says '"X" paused ..., and the project's test fails on its work: continue or cancel it in the Inbox.'. The next brief (whereTheLastRunStopped) says the next step first, the checks, a failed check's output quoted as JSON data, and 'Make a failed check pass first, unless it tests work that is still on its list.'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: In the project's folder add a package.json whose test script fails. Run a session that pauses the larger task. The Inbox card body reads 'This session's budget was CHF 2.00; the project's test fails on its work.' and the session result says '... and the project's test fails on its work: continue or cancel it in the Inbox.'. The check's output never shows on the card.

fixed.problem: OP-4 and OP-5: a pause at the specialist's limit per run ended the task's work in the session with a card, however much budget the session had left. A pause that got no further filed the same card again, and at an outer limit went on by itself every time the limit changed (a loop).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/oversize-pause.test.ts 'OP-5: a pause at its specialist's limit with progress goes on at once in the session, with no card between; the log says so once', 'OP-4, OP-5: run again, the second pause got no further: one card that asks, no third run, never 'goes on by itself'', 'OP-3, OP-4: Continue with a note on the question: the note reaches the next brief, with 'try another way'', 'OP-5: never run again after a pause at its own budget, ...', 'OP-4: at the project's budget a pause that got no further is not woken when the budget is raised; one question card asks, nothing starts; Continue with a note moves it to ready'; apps/ui/test/inbox.test.tsx 'OP-4: after a pause that got no further it asks; Continue sends the note with the choice'
fixed.how: madeProgress compares the work hash and the list length with the task's last paused run. At the specialist's limit with progress, a fifth of the work budget left, no Stop after this task and runs left (at most 6), the runner emits session.task_continues ('The coder goes on with "X" from where it stopped.') and runs the task again at once. Otherwise the card stores no_progress. Its title is '"X" paused again without getting further', Continue takes a note (input 'note') and the note goes to the task's notes. wakeBudgetWaits never wakes a no-progress card. Once its outer limit has room it withdraws the card as 'asked_again' and files one question card (Continue, Cancel task). The next Start does not take a no-progress pause. The next brief adds 'The last two runs of this task did not get further: try another way, ...'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench walk, second session: the log shows the task paused at the coder's limit of CHF 2.40, then 'The coder goes on with "Build the shop page..." from where it stopped.' once, then the run goes on with no card between. For no progress, make a task whose runs change nothing twice. Its card reads '"X" paused again without getting further' with a note box on Continue, and nothing starts by itself when the project budget is raised.

fixed.problem: OP-6: at the session's budget, Continue asked for the whole estimate again, or only the same amount, even when that could not fit what is left. The card's figure was taken from the task's first estimate, so it disagreed with the next Start dialog (bench: 'Continue (CHF 6.24 more)' while the next Start priced the task at about CHF 0.23).
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/oversize-pause.test.ts 'OP-6: at the session's budget Continue asks for what the work left needs to fit the next session' and 'OP-6, OP-8: the card's estimate and what is left of it are the ones the next Start prices the task at (the learned estimate, not the task's first figure)'
fixed.how: continueUsdMicro uses max(the same amount, ceil(estimate left / (1 - 0.2))) at the session's budget. The card stores estimate_usd_micro and estimate_left_usd_micro priced as the planner and startCheck price the task: the new Planner.wholeEstimateOf (StaticPlanner's learned estimate, else the task's own figure, its budget or the default; SeedOnlyPlanner delegates), less the kept work, within the task's budget.
fixed.check_in_the_app: After the walk's first session, the card's button 'Continue (CHF 2.00 more)' and the next Start dialog's figure for the same task (about CHF 0.89) come from the same estimate: Continue is at least what lets CHF 0.89 fit a session's work budget.

The specialist-limit card did not say what this run spent of its limit per run. After a Continue the session line did not give the task's spend in all. fixed.how: Each fact is stored once on the card (no_progress, kept_checks, estimate_usd_micro, estimate_left_usd_micro, run_spent_usd_micro), and old cards read as before. request-words adds 'It spent X of its budget of Y, more than its estimate of Z.' and, for the specialist's limit, 'It has no budget of its own: this run spent X of the Y it may spend per run.'. pauseSentence says 'this run spent X, Y in all,'. budgetPauseLabelOf and budgetPauseDetailOf in task-words.ts give the wrap-up labels ('Paused before the session's budget ran out', 'Paused before its budget ran out', 'Paused before its limit per run ran out').

new_problems: The result line 'Left for next time: "Build the shop page in shop.html" (about CHF 1.65); this session's CHF 5.00 was used. CHF 2.71.' says the budget was used when only CHF 2.71 of CHF 5.00 was spent. The critic's retry (estimate CHF 1.65) did not fit the work room left (about CHF 1.29). The sentence comes from result.ts's generic left-out line (U-040) and is said whenever a task is left out. Seen on the bench, session 01a1e088-82ce-7298-b132-31545ba4d34b. Not changed here: per the spec, a task that only does not fit what is left is 'Left for next time', and the wording needs a design decision.

The learned estimate moves a lot from one session's samples. On the fresh bench the Start dialog said the shop 'needs about CHF 6.40'. After one session (the intro, estimate set to USD 0.05, done for CHF 0.01; the shop paused after CHF 1.41), the next Start priced what is left of the shop at about CHF 0.89, so the whole estimate became about CHF 2.30. On an older bench home the same flow priced it at CHF 0.23 ('estimate passed', a fifth). This is the estimates model (packages/runtime/src/estimates/model.ts), not this area. The card and the Start dialog now agree (f629e37), but the figure itself can swing between two Starts.
notes_for_other_areas: Plan items: PlanItem.wholeEstimateUsdMicro marks the larger task taken at its place (its figure is the room). LeftOutItem.reason adds 'after_large' with `after` (the larger task's title) and 'no_room'. 'one_large' is gone from the runtime but kept in the api-types enum for old daemons.
Runner: takeLarger(item) and TOOK_LARGER_EVENT (once, not for `again`). The re-plan orders after_large first, and taken tasks leave leftOutForBudget (undefined when empty).

Continue next time: budget-card.ts continuesAtStart(card), continuableTasks(store, projectId), closeByStart, CLOSED_BY_START_OUTCOME = 'went_on_at_start'. The Done line is 'Your session of HH:MM went on with it.'. C3 (d1109-starts-engine) should keep a no-progress pause out of any automatic start.

New Planner method: wholeEstimateOf?(task) => number | undefined (StaticPlanner = learned estimate, else est_cost, budget, default; SeedOnlyPlanner delegates). Use it for any figure that must agree with the Start dialog.

New SessionRunnerDeps.keptWorkCheck?: KeptWorkCheckPort (loop/kept-work-check.ts keptWorkChecker({store, sandbox, redact})); compose wires it in one hunk with the critic's sandbox port. critic.ts now exports codeTaskChecks and startsIn.
Run rows: artifacts carry { kept: { hash, checks?: KeptCheck[], notRun?, noProgress? } } (budget-pause.ts RunKept, keptArtifact, keptOf, madeProgress).
Event: TASK_CONTINUES_EVENT = 'session.task_continues' (person event), line 'The coder goes on with "X" from where it stopped.' (oversize-words continuesLine).

Budget card change_card fields: no_progress, kept_checks {passed, failed}, estimate_usd_micro, estimate_left_usd_micro, run_spent_usd_micro, question (true on the question card), plus outcome 'asked_again'. Continue on any budget card accepts { choice, note } and the note becomes a task note.

task-words.ts: budgetPauseLabelOf(card) and budgetPauseDetailOf(card) now decide the wrap-up labels and the no-progress detail (this touches the label function C3 also reads). Session-budget/specialist-limit detail: 'Your next Start goes on with it, or Continue in the Inbox.'

StartCheckOversized gains before: string[] and comesAfter: string[]. StartCheckOversizedView gains comesAfter (default []) and afterSentence (nullable). oversizedPlanClause takes a third argument, after.

Sentences changed (old -> new): 'after the other tasks it works with about CHF N' -> 'after "A" it works with about CHF N'; 'one task that large runs a session, so it waits for the next one' -> '"B" comes after it: it runs if "X" leaves budget, else in your next session.' / '"B" waits for your next session: "X" used the rest of this one.'; row 'Paused at its budget' (wrap-up) -> 'Paused before its budget ran out'; 'this run spent X' -> 'this run spent X, Y in all,'.
